notes.title: Updated
notes.notes:
Updated as it may have fixed the bug that exits on fullscreen startup. If you open "System.ini" and rewrite it to "WindowMode=0", you can start full screen, but it may end depending on the environment, so it is not recommended.
フルスクリーン起動時に落ちるバグを修正できたかもしれないのでアップデートしました。『System.ini』を開いて『WindowMode=0』に書き換えるとフルスクリーン起動できますが、環境によっては落ちると思いますので非推奨です。

notes.title: Version.2.0
notes.notes:
Added 3 stages to the mission mode.
Chinchilla Stage: Appears with a total score of 5000 points or more.
100 Crocodile Stage: Appears after the ending.
Emperor Battle: Appears after the ending.

notes.title: Variable window mode
notes.notes:
This game may not be set to full screen in the latest Windows environment. However, if you open "System.ini" and rewrite it to "WindowMode = 2", you can switch to variable window mode. If you want to play in a slightly different environment, you may want to give it a try. This is the same for other Action Editor 4 games.

WindowMode=2 … It changes to the window mode of the variable size. The frame of the window is dragged and the size is changed freely. It is effective only in the Direct3D mode.

notes.title: Ver.1.2
notes.notes:
Added stages to mission mode, added visuals and effects, and adjusted game balance.
ミッションモードにステージを追加、ビジュアルとエフェクトを追加、ゲームバランスの調整をしました。

notes.title: ver.1.1
notes.notes:
Fixed some game balance and display bugs.
一部ゲームバランス、表示の不具合を修正。

Corrected some manuals and in-game instructions.
マニュアルとゲーム中の説明を一部修正しました。
